candidate: Tyrone Mine Dam 3X top-surface cover treatments
fatal_blocker: The public as-built drawing certifies named treatment polygons, areas, test-pit measurements and as-built topography, but it does not publish a coordinate grid, northing/easting vertices, GIS file or other georeferenced boundary data for Test Plots 5 and 6. The 2020 closure plan and 2021 permit identify the 3X impoundment as reclaimed and partially released from financial assurance, but they do not preserve the exact test-plot boundaries or certify that the proposed clean interiors remained physically unchanged throughout a usable Sentinel-1 period. Georeferencing the 2006 plate by matching contours or current imagery would introduce unsupported positional assumptions.
key_evidence: Test Plot 5 is a 4.06-acre top-surface treatment and Test Plot 6 is a 4.50-acre top-surface treatment within the reclaimed 3X Tailing Impoundment.

The plots were constructed concurrently with full-scale reclamation using Gila Conglomerate cover material placed in lifts; the upper six inches were selectively handled to meet common material requirements.
Both treatments received the same seedbed preparation, seeding, mulching and crimping procedure.
Five final confirmation pits per plot produced directly measured thickness values and a reported mean with a 95-percent confidence interval.

The engineering plate shows survey-derived as-built topography, treatment boundaries and instrumentation, but no coordinate grid, datum-based polygon vertices or numerical horizontal positioning accuracy.
The plot polygons are approximately 110 metres wide in their narrow dimension, so size itself is not the blocker.
Localized subsidence and repair occurred around lysimeters and instrumentation after construction; those features can be excluded spatially only after exact georeferencing, which is unavailable.
The 2020 closure plan states that 3X reclamation was completed in 2005, storm-channel corrective work was completed in early 2007 and a CQA report was submitted in 2008.
The 2021 permit identifies the reclaimed 3X impoundment among units with partial financial-assurance release, but does not provide plot-specific unchanged-condition certification.
next_action: Continue the approved search for similarly large named measured treatment polygons whose final as-built boundaries are published with coordinates or georeferenced GIS/CAD data and whose unchanged Sentinel-1 period is documented.
